description: Land Aquisition - Weliwa, Pitabeddara D/S Division, Matara District.
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (Lot Nos. 01 and 02 in Mahakumbura), their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for acquisition. It falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it deals with government acquisition of land for public purposes, including the notification process for interested parties to claim compensation.
